import socket,json,time
host="104.165.1.52"
out={}
for port in (6637,16637):
 row={"port":port}
 start=time.monotonic()
 try:
  s=socket.create_connection((host,port),timeout=5)
  s.settimeout(4)
  row["tcp"]="connected"
  if port==16637:
   s.sendall(b'\x05\x02\x00\x02')
   reply=s.recv(2)
   row["socks5_method_code"]=(reply[1] if len(reply)==2 and reply[0]==5 else "invalid_or_timeout")
  else:
   s.sendall(b"CONNECT api.telegram.org:443 HTTP/1.1\r\nHost: api.telegram.org:443\r\n\r\n")
   data=s.recv(240)
   line=data.decode("latin1","replace").split("\r\n")[0][:125]
   row["connect_status"]=line if line.startswith("HTTP/") else "not_http_connect"
 except Exception as e:row["error_type"]=type(e).__name__
 finally:
  try:s.close()
  except Exception:pass
 row["elapsed_ms"]=int((time.monotonic()-start)*1000)
 out[str(port)]=row
print(json.dumps(out,ensure_ascii=True))
